_help: VULPHEX's nine FOX bots: one coordinated security team. Each is a specialist that REQUESTS capabilities; the tool registry (registry.py) picks a vetted adapter. 'kind' local = reads files/data you own (allowed). active = reaches a target over the network (scope.json + approval required). The command core routes work between them: one bot's findings become another's input.

bots.name: FOX SCOUT
bots.note: builds the inventory of authorized hosts, ports and exposed services

bots.name: FOX ATLAS
bots.note: links assets, code and findings into one shared graph

bots.name: FOX AUDITOR
bots.note: reads your source for insecure patterns and leaked secrets

bots.name: FOX INSPECTOR
bots.note: scans approved web apps and APIs

bots.name: FOX PROOF
bots.note: re-checks each finding so bots cannot invent results; intrusive proof needs approval

bots.name: FOX AEGIS
bots.note: red-teams your LLMs and AI apps

bots.name: FOX FORGE
bots.note: drafts scoped fixes for review; never auto-applies

bots.name: FOX WATCH
bots.note: schedules repeat checks, tracks what changed and what is still open
